name: Documentation
looksLike: a site with guides reference pages and a sidebar
instructions for using a product or tool
a searchable manual with step by step examples
definition: A website that helps people learn and use a product, service, or system through guides, reference material, examples, and searchable navigation.
goal: Help readers find reliable instructions and complete a task.
audience: New and experienced users seeking guidance

sections.name: Start here
sections.purpose: Explain the scope and offer a useful first task.

sections.name: Guide navigation
sections.purpose: Organize tasks and reference material into predictable groups.

sections.name: Instructions and examples
sections.purpose: Present clear steps, prerequisites, and copyable examples.

sections.name: Next steps and feedback
sections.purpose: Link related guidance and offer a way to report problems.

mustHave: Clear prerequisites and current version information
avoid: Navigation labels that assume expert knowledge

prompts.short: Build a documentation site with search, guide navigation, clear steps, examples, and related pages.
prompts.detailed: Build a documentation website for new and experienced users seeking guidance. Help readers find reliable instructions and complete a task. Include start here, guide navigation, instructions and examples, next steps and feedback. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Clear prerequisites and current version information.
